answer: Let a newcomer step onto the jetty of paid work only when a sponsor puts money beside it. Trigger: the newcomer locks a 4,600 POA bond and the sponsor co-stakes 2,400 POA. Rule: for ninety days deliveries are judged through the prism of the sponsor's record; a proven duplicate burns both stakes and strips the sponsor's standing, so trust reaches its zenith only after verified work. One hundred fakes cost 460,000 POA plus 240,000 in sponsor stakes.
